race.comment: JADA ROSE (8) disappointed here last time when sent out favourite after being bumped at the start. She is fitter third-up, gets a winning rider back aboard and her first-up CL1 run at Eagle Farm over 1000m was solid enough to suggest she can rebound sharply. MISHANI VISION (9) looks the danger after a Sunny Coast second as favourite, beaten a length, and that followed a soft Ipswich Mdn win where she had something in hand. SUMMER STUNNER (13) ties in directly through the same track race as JADA ROSE, having run second to Baltray and beaten that rival home, while her Ipswich fifth before that was better than the market expected. ARISTOCRATIC GIRL (7) brings winning form after just arriving in a Mdn at Ipswich on heavy ground, and her wet-track record gives her a genuine platform to carry that confidence into this.
